productFit.name: Sky-Watcher Star Adventurer Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: Astroshop.de lists it as 'Skywatcher Stativ für AZ-5, AZ-GTi, AZ-Pronto und Star Adventurer' (art. 55848): 3/8" connection, accessory tray, aluminium, 1,8 kg, 69,5-121,5 cm. These retailer figures differ from the English post (63,5-113,7 cm, 2,35 kg, High Point Scientific) and are not the maker's; keep the English figures so the numbers match the English post.
productFit.reason: Astroshop.de (DE, also .es/.nl/.eu) sells the Sky-Watcher tripod for Star Adventurer under the same name, in stock; a German forum buyer chose it for his Seestar S50.

productFit.name: Manfrotto Befree Advanced Lever Tripod Kit
productFit.variant: In the EU the lever aluminium kit is sold as MKBFRLA4BK-BH (the English source names the US code MKBFRLA4BK-BHUS); same tripod and 494 ball head.
productFit.metricSpecs: 1,59 kg with head, 128 cm column down, 151 cm column up, 40 cm folded, 9 kg safety payload (Manfrotto); same as the English post.

productFit.name: Manfrotto 055 Aluminum 3-Section Tripod (MT055XPRO3)
productFit.metricSpecs: Manfrotto (global-de): 170 cm max., 140 cm column down, 9 cm min., 61 cm closed, 2,5 kg, 3 sections; the English post keeps a 9 kg load, keep it.
productFit.reason: Manfrotto sells it in the EU under the same model code (German maker page).

productFit.name: SmallRig FreeBlazer 72-Inch Carbon Fiber Tripod Legs (4167)
productFit.metricSpecs: SmallRig: 79-182 cm working height, 3,7 kg, 25 kg load, carbon (same as the English post).
productFit.reason: SmallRig's German store and German dealers (Foto Mayr, Foto Leistenschneider) list the 4167 FreeBlazer; amazon.de lists it too.

productFit.name: ZWO Seestar TH10 Tripod Head with TC20 Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: TC20 235-365 mm, 600 g, 30 kg; TH10 411 g, 5 kg (ZWO; same as the English post). Seestar's German FAQ gives the S50 as 2,5 kg and its tripod as 0,65 kg.
productFit.reason: EU shops sell the pair: Telescopiomania (ES) lists a 'Tripod and head pack (TC20+TH10) for Seestar'; Astroshop.de lists the 'ZWO Videoneiger TH10 Seestar Smart Telescope'.

localFacts.fact: Seestar's German FAQ: 'Der Seestar S50 wiegt 2,5 kg. Das Stativ wiegt 0,65 kg.'

Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg. By folded length the Befree Advanced (40 cm) and the TC20 (26,5 cm) fit; the Manfrotto 055 (61 cm) and the FreeBlazer (85 cm) go in checked baggage.

Sternenpark Westhavelland (Brandenburg) has ten official Beobachtungsplätze recommended for amateur astronomers; several have concrete pads or a Plattenweg for telescopes, others are meadows; visitors are asked to stay on the paths.
German terms: Stativ, Mittelsäule, Polhöhenwiege / EQ-Wedge, Neiger (TH10 = 'Videoneiger' at Astroshop), Nivellierbasis, 3/8-Zoll-Fotogewinde, Zubehörablage / Spreizteller, Feldspitzen / Spikes.

localPainPoints.pain: The stock tripod is too low for a balcony railing or for setting up without bending down.
localPainPoints.fix: Star Adventurer tripod (the forum poster bought it) or the 055 at 140 cm without the column.

quotes.text: das Originalstativ des Seestar ist für das Geländer meiner Balkonsternwarte zu niedrig, außerdem suche ich etwas rückenfreundliches fürs Feld.

localPainPoints.pain: Leveling first, then screwing the S50 on, moves the tripod; the built-in bubble on a budget tripod can be off.
localPainPoints.fix: A leveling base or the FreeBlazer's 75 mm bowl; trust the Seestar app's level, not the tray bubble; tighten the leg rings after leveling.

quotes.text: Somit erst das Stativ nivellieren und dann den Seestar aufschrauben. Hierbei findet natürlich zwangsläufig Bewegung am Stativ statt
Die eingelassene Dosenlibelle ist komplett misjustiert, bloß nicht draufschauen!

localPainPoints.pain: In EQ mode with the TH10 the centre of gravity shifts, so full height feels risky.
localPainPoints.fix: Legs fully spread, not at maximum height, column down (English setup steps 1, 2 and 6).

quotes.text: Aufgrund des verlagerten Schwerpunkts stelle ich das Stativ dann aber nicht auf maximale Höhe und achte auf etwas breiteren Stand

localPainPoints.pain: On a meadow the tripod sinks without field spikes.
localPainPoints.fix: FreeBlazer's steel spikes, or set up on the concrete pads of the Westhavelland observing sites.

quotes.text: Bei weichem Untergrund steht das Stativ sonst nicht stabil.

localGain.point: Which picks fit a Lufthansa cabin bag (55 x 40 x 23 cm) by folded length.
Where to set up in a German Sternenpark: concrete pads and paths at the Westhavelland observing sites, spikes for meadows.
German owners' leveling trap (level, then screw on, tripod moves) and the fix.
